title: #80 - Margaery
content:
#80 - Margaery

Chapter 80 Margaery

Their cousin was naturally Margaery Tyrell, nicknamed Little Rose.

She smiled at Arthur, a stranger, first, and then greeted her cousins.

Her gentle eyes, like those of an elk, seemed to always be smiling, and the corners of her mouth were raised from time to time, showing her good mood and making her gorgeous face even more dazzling.

Her long brown curly hair lazily draped over her shoulders, highlighting the whiteness of her arms; due to the usual high temperature in the River Bay, she wore a very cool dark-colored ankle-length skirt, and the cyan belt outlined her peerless figure.

Of course, what also attracted Arthur's attention was the rich capital on her chest.

He only knew such a big thing now.

In short, Margaery deserves the title of peerless beauty.

Compared with Sansa, who still only looks at the face, Margaery, who is much more mature in dealing with people, is actually very feminine.

Arthur has begun to struggle over whether to marry her or Sansa, although in fact he is still a little far from the level of these two.

After struggling for a long time, Arthur came to his own conclusion: it is not impossible to marry both of them as his wife.

One can get the entire North, and the other can get the support of the Riverlands and a generous dowry.

If you dream, you have to be bolder.

"This is Arthur Bracken, is..." Hopper was still thinking about introducing his cousin, but was interrupted by her.

"I know, it's the champion of the lance competition in the tournament of Lord Stark." She said this, but her eyes turned to Arthur.

"In the past few days, your name has made my ears calloused. Who wouldn't like a handsome and powerful knight?"

There is a problem with this statement. Arthur is not a knight, and many people know this fact.

The small loophole shows that Margaery is not very concerned about Arthur, but routinely remembers current events and pretends to be familiar with him.

This made the Lord of the Red Mill a little disappointed, but he quickly adjusted.

Who made him just a small noble now?

When he raises his own army and dominates the entire continent, Little Rose will surely remember every rumor about him clearly.

"It is my honor to let a lady from an official family like you hear my deeds." Arthur also made a polite remark.

After all, we just met, it is impossible to have a deep relationship with her.

There will be a chance to have a deep relationship with her in the future.

After the routine greetings, several people sat together at the table, and their followers found seats to sit down.

"Are you going to the school you run again?"

"Stay away from the common people, they are very barbaric."

The two brothers seemed to know what Margaret did in the morning and advised her.

Little Rose smiled faintly, "How can the cousins talk? As long as you treat them well, the common people will treat you well."

Arthur agreed with this: "That's right, one heart for one heart, they are also human beings, and they will be influenced."

"You see, this Mr. Arthur is very sensible. The purpose of my school is to influence the common people from an early age. You and I have known each other for so many years, but your awareness is not as good as that of Lord Bracken, whom I just met."

Margaret echoed Arthur and refuted the attitude of the cousins.

The twins knew the style of their cousins and did not entangle with her on this topic.

Arthur really wanted to chat with her.

Firstly, for her, and secondly, he also wanted to run a school or something, which is a magic weapon to brush up his reputation among the common people.

"Can you tell me about your school?" Arthur asked.

"Of course, Lord Champion."

Margaret used to suffer from her actions not being recognized by the upper nobles of the River Bay. Now that she saw someone who agreed with her, she immediately told the story happily.

Arthur listened carefully for a long time, and then summarized the situation of the school.

The teachers are all educated and gentle monks, and the Rose family provides food and accommodation. Margaret did not mention the salary of these monks, and Arthur was not easy to ask.

The location is in this ferry town.

The students are the teenagers and farm girls nearby.

The main reason why parents agree to let them go to school is that they are still young and cannot help work in the fields and workshops. If they are left at home, they are afraid of being demolished, falling into the river, being taken away by animals, and other accidents. It is best to have someone take care of them.

Parents don’t really care about learning some knowledge.

Who made them born as commoners? No matter how much children learn, it is useless.

When they grow up to the age of being able to work, even the lord’s daughter can’t convince them to let their children continue to go to school.

Fortunately, the things taught by the monks are also very simple, and they can be completed in one or two years.

In other words, this school not only serves the function of a school, but also has some functions of a nursery.

This allows parents who are engaged in production to work with complete peace of mind, without worrying about their children being left unattended.

"This is a great initiative, liberating parents who are tired of taking care of their children, and also giving children a safe place to go." Arthur highly praised Margaret's behavior.

"You are too polite, I just have nothing to do so I just do some small things."

Although Margaret was very modest, she was still happy in her heart.

Finally someone can understand my behavior, and he is a handsome man.

"A young lady from an official family like you who cares about the people and the people is worthy of being a queen. The two in the Red Castle are actually very..."

Arthur mentioned it again, but Margaret signaled him to stop.

"Queen Cersei and King Robert are both qualified rulers, and I am loyal to them."

Margaery, in a good mood, even made a heart gesture with both hands in front of her chest to express her loyalty to the Iron Throne.

She liked Arthur more and more. This man not only recognized her behavior of holding a school, but also said what she wanted to be in her heart.

Queen is her goal.

I want to be the king's woman!

Arthur carefully observed Margaery's expression.

Although she denied her ambition, from some flashes of her eyes, he could still guess Little Rose's ambition.

In these flashes of eyes, the left eye was full of power and the right eye was full of desire.

It was very different from her usual peaceful and gentle eyes.

"Speaking of which, I also want to hold a school in my own territory, which is a great thing for the people. There are some questions that I have to ask the experienced Miss Margaery for advice. I hope you will give me some advice."

Arthur said so.

This is actually a lie. The War of the Five Kings is about to break out. How can he have time to do these things?

But Margaery is very fond of this.

During the time before the dishes were served, she told Arthur in detail about the troubles she encountered and the problems that should be paid attention to in running a school.

Arthur admired Margaery's beauty while echoing her remarks.

The two brothers of the Redwyne family could not interrupt and had to listen silently.

"Your experience has benefited me a lot. When I return to the territory and deal with the disputes with my northern neighbors, I will open a school."

This is the ending of Arthur's experience to Margaery.

"Your northern neighbors still have disputes with you. Can you tell me about it?"

Little Rose was really interested.

Now the twins have a chance to speak.

The two of them competed to tell their cousin about the recent conflict between Arthur and Raventree City, and worked hard to praise the peerless combat power of the Lord of the Red Mill.

"Cousin, do you know what it means to kill 300 enemies on the battlefield?"
